data.title: 墨染希 · 枫林私汤的绯红水汽
data.description: 后山深处的私人温泉被层层枫树环绕，绯红落叶铺满池畔。希浸泡在温热的泉水里，白皙的肩颈在水雾中泛着迷人的浅粉。当水声轻响时，她下意识将泉水捧起遮在身前，水滴自发梢滴落，眼中既有害羞也有期待已久的深情。
data.action: soaking in onsen, water droplets, maple leaves floating, shy gaze
data.lighting: golden dusk glowing through crimson maple leaves
data.promptProse: Surrounded by fiery red autumn maples, Sumizome Nozomi soaks in a private hot spring as golden sunset filters through the trees. Clear steaming water ripples around her delicate shoulders as she blushes with shy, radiant beauty.
data.animaCaption: Nozomi blushing in a secluded maple-lined hot spring at sunset.
